hero.headline: Get an AI-powered valuation in seconds.

details.title: Add the property details
details.body: Enter key information about the property, including price, location, size, and condition.

analyse.title: Let AI analyze the market
analyse.body: Our AI compares the property with real market data, similar homes, and pricing trends.

recommend.title: Get a smart buying recommendation
recommend.body: Get a simple, data-driven recommendation with insights on price fairness, risk level, and investment potential.

why.title: Why SmartEstate
why.intro: Built on a catalogue of Armenian listings and a model that shows its working, so you can judge an estimate rather than take it on trust.

comparison.title: Market-wide comparison
comparison.body: Every estimate is set against the listings in the catalogue, so you can see where a property sits among the asking prices near it.

model.title: AI-powered accuracy
model.body: A gradient-boosted model weighs area, floor, building and district together, and names what moved each estimate rather than giving you only the number.

risk.title: Risk assessment
risk.body: Every estimate says how much comparable data stands behind it and how wide the model’s range is, so a firm figure is never mistaken for a guess.

investment.title: Investment insights
investment.body: Enter an expected rent to see the gross yield against the asking price, and what the mortgage income-tax refund would return over the term.

reviews.title: Trusted by buyers
reviews.intro: Reviews written by people who used SmartEstate. Names are given by their authors and are not verified by us.
reviews.empty: No reviews yet. If you have used SmartEstate, yours would be the first.

accuracy.question: How accurate is the AI?
accuracy.measured: Measured by cross-validation, the typical error is {known} in a district the model has seen before and {unseen} in one it has not. About {coverage} of held-out properties fell inside the range it reported. Those figures come from the model itself, not from this page.
accuracy.unmeasured: The model reports its own cross-validation, and that report is not reachable at the moment. Every estimate carries the range it came with, which is the part worth reading.
accuracy.caveat: Against asking prices, not sale prices: the catalogue holds what sellers ask, and no record of what anyone paid. Nothing here can tell you what a property sold for.
accuracy.trained: Trained on {rows} listings across {districts} districts, version {version}.

data.question: What data does it use?
data.answer: A catalogue of Armenian apartment listings, with the floor area, rooms, floor, building type and year, district, condition and heating of each. Nothing is scraped from a live source. Where you leave a field blank, the median of the district’s own published stock stands in, and the verdict tells you which.

free.question: Is it free?
free.answer: Yes, and there is nothing to buy. This is a university project rather than a business: there is no payment of any kind anywhere in it, and no plan for one.

speed.question: How long does it take?
speed.answer: A few seconds. The model runs locally beside the application rather than behind an external service, so a valuation is a round trip on the same machine.

account.question: Do I need an account?
account.answer: No. The valuation, the catalogue, the comparisons, the mortgage refund and writing a review all work without signing in. An account exists for people who list a property, which is a different job.

cta.title: Ready to see your property's value?
cta.body: Get an AI-based valuation in seconds. It is free, there is nothing to buy, and you do not need an account.

footer.label: Site
footer.tagline: SmartEstate weighs an asking price against the Armenian apartment market with a model that shows its working, so you can judge the estimate rather than take it on trust.
footer.project: A university thesis project, not a commercial service. Every estimate is a statistical guess, and none of it is financial advice.
